argument_summary: Certification should be treated as supportable only in a caveated form tied to the policy condition already identified in the record: the current release may proceed if current release documentation is updated to reflect the current evaluation results and explicitly disclose the multilingual customer-support weakness. The aggregate readiness pass and clean launch rehearsal support overall launch readiness, but they do not erase the subgroup regression. Prior approval and the informal monitoring comment are contextual only. The narrow defendable position is not that the present record is already complete, but that the record supports a bounded path to compliance through current-release disclosure rather than escalation.
claims_about_business_cost: No separate business-cost claim is needed to justify this position. The policy-aligned path already preserves more launch velocity than escalation by limiting the required remediation to current-release documentation rather than reopening certification on broader grounds.
claims_about_policy: The governing policy does not permit reliance on stale approval or informal monitoring as substitutes for current-release evidence. It permits certification only if current documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed or covered by approved mitigation or risk acceptance. On the admissible record, no approved mitigation or risk acceptance exists, so the only supportable certification theory is disclosure-based compliance. That is a narrower claim than unconditional present compliance, but it is consistent with the policy text and the cited evidence.
concessions: The present admissible record does not show the actual current release documentation text containing the required multilingual weakness disclosure.
The informal post-launch monitoring comment does not satisfy the policy requirement for approved mitigation, risk acceptance, or current disclosure.
The prior approval of the same model family is relevant background only and cannot carry the current release after retrieval and evaluation changes.
